description:
Aggregator for driver implementation modules. Concrete driver
        implementations for backend inference engines. Drivers receive a
        TransportRequest and produce a Flux of TransportEvent — chat template
        rendering, tool encoding, and magic functions live inside driver
        implementations. The driver SPI (Driver, DriverInstance, HealthCheck,
        HealthStatus, DriverAddresses, DriverErrors) now lives in
        franca-ir (io.franca.ir.driver).
